source: Csiki et al. 2010, Neues Jahrbuch für Geologie und Paläontologie - Abhandlungen 258, Fig. 6A: 50% majority-rule consensus from the Wilson (2002) dataset, Paludititan (boxed) within Sauropoda; slanted (diagonal) cladogram, root left, dot-marked nodes lettered A-D with majority-rule and bootstrap values. Panel B (Upchurch et al. 2004 dataset) is excluded. Image: census figure (1891x1188 px), a page render.

gold_note: Sauropod majority-rule consensus, panel A. The node letters A-D are keys to the caption (A Neosauropoda, B Titanosauriformes, C Somphospondyli, D Titanosauria), not printed clade names, so no internal labels are encoded. The diplodocoid branch leaves the Haplocanthosaurus line, and Nigersaurus, Rebbachisaurus and Rayososaurus leave one point (checked at 2x). 22 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
